title: Generative UI V1 (2a of 4): scene renderer and gallery, not yet wired in
requested_outcome: Owner-approved Generative UI V1 (docs/product-memory/GENERATIVE_UI_V1.md), objective 2a of 4: the scene renderer, built beside the live app and not wired into it, so nothing the owner sees changes yet. Objective 1 landed app/scenes (evidence model, descriptors, scene-plan schema, validator with decision trace). Build: (1) app/scenes/payload.py - a pure, deterministic function that turns a validated scene plus its evidence into a JSON render payload with every value resolved and formatted for display: money with its currency symbol, ratios as percentages or multiples as the descriptor says, counts, durations in plain words, datetimes in Europe/London in plain relative words, series as numeric arrays; pii fields only when the validated scene kept them; each element keeps its id and justification for the trace but the justification is not display text. (2) web/scenes.js - renderScene(payload, container) that draws the closed primitive set with the existing design tokens in web/style.css (no new fonts or colours): Answer as the lead line; Finding with its significance in plain words (needs you, decide, risk, unsure, limit, context) and a tap to reveal its evidence; Entity as label and value rows; Collection as a compact table with the chosen columns and a 'show all' drill-down past its row limit; Measure as a large value with unit and period; Comparison with the difference stated; Trend as an inline SVG sparkline; Timeline as dated rows; Proposal as a card whose button dispatches a CustomEvent('scene-proposal') and does nothing else; Question with option chips dispatching CustomEvent('scene-answer'); and the drill-down line listing what was checked when only the Answer is shown. All text goes through textContent, never innerHTML. Generous spacing, few elements, no filler: the screen should read as a premium work surface, not a dashboard. (3) web/scenes.css for these styles, loaded only by the gallery for now. (4) web/scenes-gallery.html with web/scene-fixtures.js: a standalone page, served under /static like the rest of web/ and not linked from the app, rendering at least the 2026-09-24 'customers who need a reply' case (one Answer plus drill-down), a nothing-needs-you case (one line), an ads-connector scene (Answer, Finding, Trend), a Collection over its row limit, a Proposal and a Question, so the owner can see the new look on his phone before it is wired in. (5) Tests: tests/test_scene_payload.py (formatting per kind, pii kept only when allowed, determinism) and tests/web/scenes.test.js under node with the existing dom-shim (every primitive renders, text is escaped, row limits and drill-down hold, events are dispatched), run by a new test function in tests/test_web_js.py like the other node suites there; change nothing else in that file. Do not modify web/app.js, web/index.html, web/style.css, app/presentation.py, app/render.py or any route. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: app/scenes/payload.py resolves and formats every value from evidence, deterministically, with pii only when the validated scene kept it
web/scenes.js renders every primitive with the existing design tokens, escapes all text, and dispatches events instead of acting
the gallery renders the listed cases, including the 2026-09-24 case as one Answer plus drill-down and the nothing-needs-you case as one line
nothing the live app loads or renders changes
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
